01 · Our story

A little piece of Portugal, open to everyone

Beira Alta is a neighbourhood café in the heart of Boston — the kind of place where the coffee is strong, the pastries come out fresh through the day, and the welcome is warm no matter who walks through the door.

Our counter is proudly Portuguese: rich coffee, freshly baked cakes and pastries, and hearty, comforting plates cooked with care. But you don't need to speak a word of Portuguese to feel at home here — locals, commuters and families all gather around the same tables, from the first espresso at dawn to a late-evening slice of cake.

Everyone is welcome. Portuguese cuisine at heart — open to all, whether you're after a quick coffee, a proper meal or just a friendly place to sit.
